title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Published Day, Week and Weekend Rates
content:
Rates below are the published amounts for an intermediate vehicle on each of the six Car Rental Rate Classes, and are the amounts the desk quotes for that class.

| Rate class | Day rate (USD) | Week rate (USD) | Weekend day rate (USD) | Extra day (USD) | Extra hour (USD) | Grace period (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 38.50 | 229.00 | 32.00 | 58.00 | 14.00 | 29 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 46.75 | 279.00 | 39.00 | 62.00 | 14.00 | 29 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 54.00 | 325.00 | 49.00 | 68.00 | 12.00 | 59 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 68.25 | 399.00 | 62.00 | 75.00 | 10.00 | 59 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 89.50 | 529.00 | 82.00 | 95.00 | 9.00 | 89 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 59.00 | 349.00 | 55.00 | 65.00 | 10.00 | 59 |

Each column is one published amount for an intermediate vehicle:

- the day rate is the published daily rate for the class;
- the week rate is the published weekly rate for the class;
- the weekend day rate is the published daily rate on Saturday and Sunday;
- the extra day amount is the rate charged for a day kept beyond the booked return;
- the extra hour amount is the charge for each hour kept beyond the grace period;
- the grace period is the number of minutes past the booked return time before a late charge begins.

**Points of judgement on the schedule.** The span between the cheapest and the dearest published day rate on these classes is from 38.5 on the Pay Now Saver Rate to 89.5 on the Premium Inclusive Rate, and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate sits at 59 between them. The grace period is 29 minutes on the two Pay Now classes, 59 minutes on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate, the Inclusive Flex Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate, and 89 minutes on the Premium Inclusive Rate; a class with a longer grace period also carries a lower extra hour amount, the Premium Inclusive Rate at 9 against 14 on the Pay Now classes.
